subject.title: fix(gateway): recover when suppressed channel secrets are unavailable

question: Should this narrower projection-only branch become the canonical fix for the linked crash-loop issue instead of the competing open branch?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same P0 defect but differ in implementation breadth, compatibility behavior, and real-behavior evidence; only one should land.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Use this narrower helper-based implementation after exact-head supervised proof confirms stable startup and recovery.

options.title: Adopt the competing branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106405 if maintainers prefer its broader fast-path changes after reviewing explicit-skip compatibility.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep both branches open until a Gateway owner defines a different canonical source-and-assignment boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch
recommendation.body: Use this narrower helper-based implementation after exact-head supervised proof confirms stable startup and recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice directly affects the crash-loop safe-mode contract introduced by their earlier feature work.
